topic: Sahih Muslim 2999: good in every affair of the believer
coreInsight: Sahih Muslim 2999: for the believer, gratitude in good times and patience in hard times both turn into good.

hookVariants.text: Both can be good for you
Strange are the ways of a believer

selectionRationale: Most relevant and clearest at a glance; the teaching pays it off.

script.onScreen: Good day or hard day? / This hadith speaks to both.
REFLECTION / Two responses / On a good day: gratitude. On a hard day: patience. Notice which one you are in today, and answer it the way this hadith describes.
Thank in ease. Endure in hardship. / Send this to someone who needs it

caption:
Whatever kind of day you're having, this hadith has a response for it.

Sahih Muslim 2999: gratitude in ease, patience in hardship, and good in both for the believer.

Today: name which one you are in, and answer it.

Send this to someone who needs it today.

📖 Sources
• Sahih Muslim 2999 (Sahih, tr. Abdul Hamid Siddiqui) — sunnah.com/muslim:2999
Full text: Suhaib reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Strange are the ways of a believer for there is good in every affair of his and this is not the case with anyone else except in the case of a believer for if he has an occasion to feel delight, he thanks (God), thus there is a good for him in it, and if he gets into trouble and shows resignation (and endures it patiently), there is a good for him in it
• Recitation: Qur'an 2:155-156 — Mohamed Siddiq Al-Minshawi (Murattal) (EveryAyah.com) — quran.com/2/155-156
